summary: Iteration 4 covers the NEW per-phase AI treatment advice endpoint + improved engine recommendation text + toast bottom-right position + full regression. Backend: extended /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py from 27 to 31 pytests, ALL 31 passing (100%). New tests specifically verify (a) POST /api/plants/{id}/phase-advice returns Claude-generated Italian advice + phase context, (b) 404 on bogus plant id, (c) engine SUGGESTION text ('Consigliato trattamento preventivo con rame o fungicida specifico.', 'Consigliato insetticida selettivo o olio di Neem.', 'Consigliato acaricida ...') appears in reason field of advisory recs when no product is configured. Frontend UI: verified end-to-end via Playwright — login admin → create Melo → auto-BBCH 14 phases → 'Fase corrente' dark card renders with phase-advice-btn → clicking generates ~945 chars of on-topic Italian advice into phase-advice-text → selecting another phase clears advice → toast is now at bottom-right (data-y-position=bottom, data-x-position=right on the Sonner Toaster). Recommendations page shows both fungal and insect SUGGESTION strings for the risky-phase Melo without configured products.

issues: Applied-at field still uses native browser <input type='date'> instead of shadcn Calendar (design consistency, LOW). Carried over from iteration_3.
Logout still lands on /accedi instead of the landing page /. LOW priority UX polish. Carried over from iteration_2/3.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py phase_advice endpoint: correctly returns 400 when current_phase_id is missing, 404 when plant/phase not found, 502 when LLM call fails. Advice prompt is well-scoped (max 180 parole, bullet points, mentions products in stock). ✔
server.py phase_advice: uses `products_in_stock` (in_stock: True) filter in the prompt — good, avoids recommending out-of-stock chemistry.

engine.py SUGGESTION dict is a clean addition; all 3 risk kinds have a suggestion; advisory rec message now reads 'Rischio ... livello X/3 in fase «...» su <plant>. Consigliato ... (Aggiungi il prodotto in magazzino ...)'. Reads naturally in Italian. ✔
Plants.jsx PlantDetail: `setPhase` clears `advice` state before hitting backend — correct UX (stale advice would otherwise mislead). Same effect on manual phase-row click. ✔
App.js: <Toaster position='bottom-right' richColors /> — resolves top-right overlap flagged in iteration_3. Verified data-y-position=bottom + data-x-position=right at runtime. ✔
server.py CORS: `allow_origins=[FRONTEND_URL, 'http://localhost:3000']` with `allow_credentials=True` — cookies + preview URL both work. ✔

SUGGESTION text is emitted for EACH risk axis independently (fungal, insect, acarid) — a Fioritura Melo generates two advisory recs (fungal + insect), each with its own suggestion. Documented in test_no_product_recommendation_includes_suggestion which now verifies per reason_code.
Minor: /api/plants/{id}/phase-advice does not persist the AI reply — each click hits Claude. Consider a short cache (per plant+phase) to reduce cost + latency on re-clicks.
Minor: no explicit input validation on `question`/`plant_id` size in /api/ai/advisor — a very long question would forward to Claude unchecked.
